summary.text: John Piscopo, a Republican, has represented District 76 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 1989 and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Connecticut State University and was a legislative intern to State Senator Richard C. Bozzuto in 1976.
He volunteers with the Thomaston Opera House and the Thomaston Recycling Program.
